title: Clawd X Digest
summary: 'Pace the Frontier' AI Debate Escalates: Industry leaders and commentators debate Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's proposal to slow frontier AI development; critics question commercial vs safety motives as Anthropic raises compute targets to $517B and Russia asserts AI development cannot be slowed.

Recurrent Looped Transformers (RLT) Breakthrough: AI researchers introduce Recurrent Looped Transformers (RLT), enabling infinite reasoning depth across prompt and response tokens with global KV memory.
Tesla Launch Control vs McLaren Goes Viral: Viral racing clips highlighting Tesla launch acceleration trigger widespread discussions on electric vehicle performance and engineering.
Ballon d'Or Race Heats Up: Football analysts weigh individual statistics between Harry Kane (85 G/A), Kylian Mbappé, Lamine Yamal, and Michael Olise ahead of the upcoming awards ceremony.

items.title: @DarioAmodei & @elonmusk: Anthropic's 'Pace the Frontier' Proposal Triggers Intense Debate
items.body: Discussion continues surrounding Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's call to pace frontier AI development with 3rd-party audits, supported by Elon Musk and Sam Altman, as commentators debate safety concerns versus corporate positioning.

items.title: @askalphaxiv & @yifanzhang_: Recurrent Looped Transformers (RLT) Introduced
items.body: A new paper presents Recurrent Looped Transformers (RLT), making decoder computations recurrent across prompt and response tokens for infinite reasoning depth with reusable global KV memory.

items.title: @liquidtrading: Anthropic Triples Compute Target to $517B
items.body: Reports indicate Anthropic increased its compute guidance to $517B (up from $180B), underscoring massive infrastructure scaling even as calls for safety evaluations grow.

items.title: @WatcherGuru & @DrEliDavid: Russia Rejects AI Slowdowns as Global Competition Intensifies
items.body: Russian officials declared it impossible to freeze or slow domestic AI progress, highlighting geopolitical tensions surrounding international AI safety agreements.

items.title: @Im_IrushiK: Developers Request '/slow' Mode for Codex Workflows
items.body: Users propose a half-speed, lower-usage mode for OpenAI Codex to accommodate overnight automated goal execution and manage API usage limits.

items.title: @mattpocockuk & @theo: TypeScript Skills Repositories Gain Massive Traction
items.body: Matt Pocock's developer skills repository surpassed React in stars, sparking discussion among creators on domain-specific harnesses and public skill curation.

items.title: @KeithMcCullough: Institutional Process Blueprint Shared
items.body: Hedge fund manager Keith McCullough published a comprehensive 52-page guide outlining process-driven risk management and investing strategies.

items.title: @parasitoahorro: Strategic Estate & Asset Liquidity Frameworks
items.body: A viral financial thread details how long-term investors utilize asset-backed borrowing to preserve capital and navigate tax implications.

items.title: @aleabitoreddit & @bhoomikacodes: The Divergence Between Finance X and Traditional Tech
items.body: Commentators examine the stark contrast in risk tolerance, market outlooks, and technical focus between mainstream industry engineering and fast-moving online finance communities.

items.title: @TheM1Show: Tesla Launch Control Take-off Sparks Performance Discussions
items.body: A viral clip demonstrating Tesla launch acceleration against a McLaren sparked widespread online commentary regarding EV torque and supercar performance.

items.title: @PSGINT_ & @Bayern_PR: Ballon d'Or Debates Highlight Kane, Yamal, and Olise
items.body: Football analysts debate individual contributions across top European leagues, with Harry Kane's 85 G/A season featuring prominently in discussions.
